Chicken Curry
Ingredient [1] Heat in a deep pan [2] Temper until fragrant [3] Saute 7-8 min until deep golden [4] Saute 1 min until aromatic [5] Cook until soft and mushy [6] Stir in on low heat until aromatic [7] Fry 3 min until pale [8] Cover and cook 4 min on low [9] Simmer covered until the gravy thickens [10] Garnish and rest off the heat
2 1/2 tbsp vegetable oil Heat in a deep pan
1 bay leaf Temper until fragrant
1 cinnamon stick Temper until fragrant
4 cloves Temper until fragrant
3 green cardamom pods Temper until fragrant
3 onions finely chopped Saute 7-8 min until deep golden
2 green chilies slit Saute 7-8 min until deep golden
1 tbsp ginger garlic paste Saute 1 min until aromatic
2 tomatoes pureed Cook until soft and mushy
1/4 tsp turmeric Cook until soft and mushy
3/4 tsp salt Cook until soft and mushy
1/4 cup yogurt Stir in on low heat until aromatic
1 tsp red chili powder Stir in on low heat until aromatic
1 tsp garam masala Stir in on low heat until aromatic
1 tsp coriander powder Stir in on low heat until aromatic
1/2 kg chicken thigh Fry 3 min until pale
1 tbsp cilantro Fry 3 min until paleGarnish and rest off the heat
1/2 cup hot water Simmer covered until the gravy thickens
[8] Cover and cook 4 min on low [7] Fry 3 min until pale
